== Course of events ==

Faced with an invasion Ozma had refused to meet with arms or flight, the Scarecrow put forward a secret plan built around the Forbidden Fountain. Fine dust released into the tunnel used by the approaching army left the soldiers so thirsty that they turned to the Forbidden Fountain to drink, and in doing so they forgot the hostility that had driven the invasion, so that the attack dissolved without a blow struck.

Among the invaders were King and Roquat; King, who alone resisted the ploy, was thrown into the Forbidden Fountain as well, and the forgetting spread through the invading ranks despite his resistance. With the invading force drained of its hostility, Ozma used the Magic Belt to banish the remaining invaders back to their own home, closing the threat the Scarecrow's plan had defused.
